title: Round 8 referee calculations

At fixed liquid inventory, $G^*=G_{\rm EOS}+RT\sum_i n_i b_i(T,P_s)$ and
$G^*_P=V_{\rm EOS}+RT\sum_i n_i b_{i,P_s}\,dP_s/dP$. The reference
contributes when it tracks system pressure. At reaction equilibrium the same
envelope derivative holds on each differentiable branch at fixed conserved
feed. Sum the phase contributions for a pair and use one-sided derivatives
at a branch switch. At fixed volume the pressure-reference chain term is
$-RT^2\sum_i n_i b_{i,P_s}(\partial P/\partial T)_{V,n}$.

Peiper and Pitzer's printed water activities give
$-\ln a_w/M_w=\phi_{\rm eq}\sum_i m_i=\phi_{\rm st}\sum_s\nu_s m_s$
within printed precision. The fitted ionic target subtracts ideal dissolved
CO₂ molality from the equilibrium numerator and divides by the charge-closed
ionic molality sum.

The property errors compare model results with observations. The phase
results concern model predictions for the declared states and trial banks.
These results await independent review and investigator promotion.

## Caloric comparison

The Gibbs–Helmholtz readback evaluates $H_G=-T^2[\partial(G^*/T)/\partial T]_{P,\mathrm{feed}}$
with $G=H-TS$ and common caloric references. It holds both the system
and reference pressures fixed as temperature varies. Energies are normalized
per mole of apparent amine fed. The spread is the maximum minus
minimum of $H_{\rm Engine}-H_G$ over the retained step pairs.

| Branch | Temperature (K) | Pressure (MPa) | Finest admitted step (K) | $H_{\rm Engine}-H_G$ (kJ/mol) | Spread (kJ/mol) |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| MEA | 313.02 | 0.006675 | 0.01 | 2.70543e-06 | 4.01546e-05 |
| DEA | 313.15 | 0.007130 | 0.01 | 7.05095e-06 | unresolved |
| AMP | 353.00 | 0.088720 | 0.01 | 6.80308e-07 | 1.01959e-05 |
| MDEA | 333.16 | 0.723185 | 0.01 | 4.21098e-06 | 6.31543e-05 |
| parent | 373.15 | 204.053984 | 0.01 | 8.68589e-07 | 1.30945e-05 |
| daughter-1 | 373.15 | 204.053984 | 0.01 | 8.27536e-07 | 1.24882e-05 |
| daughter-2 | 373.15 | 204.053984 | 0.01 | 3.45823e-08 | 5.16251e-07 |
| daughters-sum | 373.15 | 204.053984 | 0.01 | 8.62118e-07 | 1.30044e-05 |

DEA pressure check misses (313.19 K at 1.41e-10, 313.17 K at 1.96e-10, 313.13 K at 1.18e-10). Liquid pressure readback exceeds relative tolerance 1e-10.
The caloric difference spans 0.000106142 kJ/mol if those same-root diagnostic values are included.

Shifting the common AMP enthalpy anchor by 1000 J/mol of apparent amine adds that constant to the Engine enthalpy. In the central difference of $G/T$, the same shift is multiplied by $T^2/(T^2-\Delta T^2)$. The largest residual change after accounting for that finite-step bias is 2.2e-06 J/mol.

The 100 kPa reference control at 204.054 MPa retains resolved descent. Its split outcome is unresolved phase identity.

> reduced_hessian_stability is indeterminate: equilibrated minimum 0.0014899558032298197, rounding band 0.018920834586390576, solve-error change 9.9529759434169307e-17 (Newton correction 2.1372300564574778e-11)

Tracking pressure confirms the split. Gibbs lowering divided by $RT$ is 0.000501594 mol on the retained feed, with an estimated numerical error of 7.18e-10 mol.

The AMP refit includes 18 supplemental Hartono pressures and 40 loaded Tong pressures. The original hot-pressure biases were -28.1% on 18 Hartono observations and -25.3% on 25 Tong observations.
